text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 多题材场景60组 · 38 · 驶向山谷的蒸汽列车餐车.
Environment:  Inside an empty luxurious but cozy fantasy steam-train dining car, cream linen tables, warm walnut trim, pale sage seats, brass luggage racks and arched windows overlooking bright misty mountain valleys. One simple porcelain tea setting, softly frosted glass lamps. No travelers, servers, reflections or portraits. View down the aisle with gentle 50mm perspective and natural tactile warmth.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic architectural elevation or cut section of the principal facade / interior wall. Show openings, vertical structure, floor levels, stair and roof relationships where visible. Readable architectural profile with restrained white margin and a short elevation title.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Reconstruct the SAME scene from reference 1 concept plan, reference 2 original look. Match plan footprint, fixed window/door/stair/furniture positions. Scene: 多题材场景60组 · 38 · 驶向山谷的蒸汽列车餐车. One flat architectural orthographic main facade elevation or interior principal wall elevation. Show openings, structural bays, vertical proportions, ceiling profile and material detail. No perspective montage, no furniture moved against the elevation. White page, title INTERIOR ELEVATION or FRONT ELEVATION. Preserve reference materials, light and style. Unseen extension conservative. Empty environment, NO people, animals, silhouettes, statues of humans, no unrelated spaces. Landscape image, no dimensions.
